question: For allowed address pairs on the port with ID `25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034`, show the allowed address pair MAC address, allowed address pair IP address, the port ID, the security group ID bound to that port, and the running average of the port’s standard attribute ID within each port (partitioned by port ID) ordered by the allowed address pair IP address, along with the total number of security group bindings on that port and the average number of security group bindings per port across all ports. prediction.sql:
WITH port_sg_counts AS (
    SELECT port_id, COUNT(*) AS sg_binding_count
    FROM securitygroupportbindings
    GROUP BY port_id
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(sg_binding_count) AS avg_sg_per_port
    FROM port_sg_counts
)
SELECT
    aap.mac_address,
    aap.ip_address,
    p.id AS port_id,
    sgpb.security_group_id,
    AVG(p.standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY p.id ORDER BY aap.ip_address) AS running_avg,
    psc.sg_binding_count AS total_bindings,
    oa.avg_sg_per_port AS avg_bindings_per_port
FROM allowedaddresspairs aap
JOIN ports p ON aap.port_id = p.id
JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON p.id = sgpb.port_id
JOIN port_sg_counts psc ON p.id = psc.port_id
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE p.id = '25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034'
ORDER BY aap.ip_address;
